sources.title: rasyosef/Llama-3.2-1B-Amharic · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a version of Meta's Llama-3.2-1B decoder transformer model that was continuously pretrained on an Amharic text corpus. 16k new amharic tokens were added to the Llama 3.2 tokenizer and the embdedding layer of the model was resized accordingly. The model was then trained on 300 million tokens of Amharic text. This is a base model.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Amharic - GitHub
sources.snippet: This is a demo for llama-3.2-amharic, a smaller version of Meta's Llama-3.2-1B decoder transformer model pretrained for 3 days on 210 million tokens of Amharic text. This model has 179 million parameters and a context size of 1024 tokens. This is a base model and hasn't undergone any supervised finetuing yet.
